data: Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, bonus fire rate, and reloads bullets on use.
Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant spirit damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.
Dealing significant spirit damage to an enemy within 5s causes an explosion dealing damage and a burn to that enemy. While burning, enemies take damage over time and receive reduced healing.
The cooldown is per enemy, so each target can only be burned once per cooldown. Deals half-damage on non-heroes.
Your next bullet deals bonus spirit damage.
Launch yourself high into the air and grant yourself a Barrier. While in the air, you can use the active again to drop down faster.
Cannot be used for 5s if attacked by enemy Hero.
Launch an expanding projectile which Silences enemies for a short duration and deals impact damage.
Silence does not interrupt channeling abilities.
Target an enemy NPC and consume it for 170% Bonus Souls and grants a powerful long lasting buff.
Launch a projectile that deals damage, applies a strong slow that recovers over time, prevents Stamina usage and Silences their movement-based items and abilities.
Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant weapon damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.
Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.
Walking through a cosmic veil grants you Stealth, Heal and increased Move Speed.
Toggle: Continually sacrifice Health to improve fire rate, Debuff Resistance and Move Speed.
When the target takes spirit damage, they have their Move Speed reduced.
Increases the range and effect radius of your abilities and items.
Grants Fire Rate, Spirit Resistance and Move Speed, and removes the Move Speed penalty while shooting, but Silences you and disables stamina usage and regeneration.
Your next parry protects you from the damage and effects of enemy abilities and items. On a successful spell parry heal and gain move speed and Spirit.
Gain a Barrier when you are Stunned, Chained, Immobilized, Slept or Silenced.
Become Stealthed. Whenever you take damage while Stealthed you get briefly revealed.
Attacking or using an ability will end your stealth and start an ambush, temporarily granting you bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Melee Damage.
Heals a target allied hero and yourself for a percentage of Max Health. Once while healing, you can Pull the target towards you. Can be self-cast.
The next instance of high spirit damage you take is significantly reduced.
Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage and Slows targets it hits.
Charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, causing abilities dealing more than 80 damage to deal additional damage.
Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals bonus weapon damage.
Your bullets build up to reduce the target's outgoing damage and apply healing reduction.
When an enemy uses an ability within 32mm range from you, store one Restoration Stack.
Consume all stacks to heal yourself and replenish up to 3 stamina based on how many stacks you have.
Disarms enemy target and reduces their Bullet Resist.
When below 50% health, gain additional Spirit Resist.
Gain bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Spirit Lifesteal by charging up when shooting enemy heroes.
Grow larger in size, gaining bullet resist, spirit resist, and melee damage.
Nearby enemies suffer from slow and have reduced dash speed.
Target an enemy to reduce their Fire Rate and Bullet Resistance.
When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, the attack deals extra spirit damage and steals Spirit Resist and Spirit Power.
Effects are reduced by 30% for Light Melee hits.
Temporarily suppress negative status effects and become immune to Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, and Disarm.
Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept.
Your bullets build up a Bleed on enemies, causing them to lose a percentage of their Max Health over time. Also applies Healing Reduction on the bleeding target.
On a successful Parry against an enemy Hero, Heal yourself for the damage parried and returns that damage to the target, and temporarily gain increased damage.
Apply a charge to a target enemy hero. After a short duration, the static charge stuns and damages enemies within the radius.
Power up your weapon with a shock effect, making your bullets proc shock damage on your target. This shock damage bounces to enemies near your target. Occurs once per burst shot.
Channel an expanding storm cloud around you that damages all enemies within its radius. Enemies do not take damage when they are out of line-of-sight.
+55% Bullet Resist while channeling Storm Cloud
Leap into the air and fly. While in flight your weapon deals bonus spirit damage and your items have increased range.
+10.0 Spirit Damage with increased Spirit scaling

Use your scoped rifle to fire a powerful shot over long distances. Deal only partial damage until fully charged after 1.0s of being scoped. Does bonus damage to enemies with less than 50% health remaining. Landing a killing blow on a player with Assassinate grants you bonus weapon damage.
Sacrifice some of your health to launch a bomb that deals damage after a brief arm time.
Self damage type is Spirit and can be mitigated.
Bombs leave a toxic mess on the ground, dealing 30.0% of the original damage per second, for 6s.
Drain health from nearby enemies, dealing spirit damage over time and healing for a portion of the damage dealt.
+2m Radius and +18.0 DPS with improved Spirit scaling
Charge forward, pulling enemies you hit. Pushing a hero into a wall applies stun.
If you collide with a hero you move faster during your charge.
On Hero Collide: +1.5 Weapon Damage for 6s

Deal weapon damage to summon cards of a random suit. Each card can be thrown, dealing damage and applying a different effect depending of its suit. Cards thrown fly towards the enemy or point under your crosshair.
All suits are improved and higher chance for Jokers
Release an energy pulse that travels along the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying knockup.
On Hit: -15% Bullet Resist and -24% Move Speed for 4s
While channeling, restore health over time to you and any allies nearby.
You can dash and melee without breaking the channel.
Aura provides +4m Move Speed during channel
Full move and ability use and additionally heals +2.5% of Max Health per second
Throw a cluster of bombs that detonate after a delay, dealing spirit damage.
Enemies hit by multiple bombs take 65% damage.
Per Bomb Touch : -6% Melee Resist for 6s
Dash forward before slashing all enemies in a circle, dealing melee damage.
If the ability hits at least one hero, heal a small amount of health.
+60 Damage & On Hero Hit: 50% Cooldown Refund
Turn to shadows and possess Ava. You gain bonus move speed that increases over time, and become hidden on the minimap.
Taking damage from an enemy hero resets your bonus move speed and puts Ava on a brief cooldown.
Gain Damage Amp over time, up to 18%. Lingers for 6s
Instantly turn to shadows, becoming untargetable, gaining bonus move speed, and dealing spirit damage.
After a delay, return from the shadows, dealing spirit damage again.
On Completion: Heal for 450 and refund all ability cooldowns
Charge up a powerful shot that pierces through enemies. Hold Ability 1 or to hold the shot.
Improved damage scaling and -3s Charge Delay
Launches you high in the air, allowing you to glide slowly. While airborne, you gain Weapon Damage and multishot on your weapon.
Press Jump / mantle to cancel the glide.
While airborne, +3 Weapon Damage and weapon damage applies 24% movement slow for 1.5s
While airborne, +30% Bullet Lifesteal, +30% Spirit Lifesteal and +30% Bullet Evasion
Burrow underground, moving faster, and gaining spirit and bullet armor. Damage from enemy heroes will reduce the speed bonus.
When you jump out, deal spirit damage, slow, and knockup.
Hold the target in place, stunning them and dealing damage during the channel. If they die during, or within 3 seconds of Combo ending, you permanently gain max health.
+0.7s Duration and +40.0 Damage Per Second and increased scaling
Turn yourself into impervious stone and smash into the ground, stunning and damaging enemies nearby. Heals you for a percentage of your max health.
+0.75s Stun Duration and increased Damage spirit scaling
Grab an ally and take flight with them. Drop your ally to cause an explosion, dealing spirit damage. You and your ally gain increased Outgoing Damage when flying ends.
Cooldown reduced by 30% when used on allies.
Taking damage briefly disables using the ability.
While lifted, your ally cannot attack and deals -20% damage.
On Fly End : 300 Barrier to Ivy and ally that scales with Spirit
Stomp the ground beneath you, damaging enemies in front of you. If you perform Ground Strike while airborne, you quickly dive towards the ground. Damage grows slower after 25m.
Struck enemies are knocked up and slowed by 40% for 3s
Damage Per Meter +120% and improved scaling
Throw a ball of goo that deals damage and leaves puddles of goo behind that apply movement slow to enemies in the radius.
Bounces 1 times and improves Spirit Scaling
Active: Consume all Djinn Mark's to deal its damage now.

Passive: Your shots apply a Djinn Mark on the target. When the mark expires or is consumed, it deals spirit damage and the target is briefly revealed on the map. Each added mark doubles the current damage.
There is a per target Cooldown for applying additional marks
On Proc: Apply a fading 48% Slow for 0.8s
Stun Victim for 0.5s on Max Marks
Throw a dagger, dealing spirit damage and applying slow.
Every subsequent dagger against the same target stacks in spirit damage and slow.
On Hit: -8% Bullet Resist and -6% Bullet Resist per Stack
Inject a target with lethal venom. After a delay the venom triggers, dealing Spirit Damage. The damage is increased by the target's missing health.
Lethal Venom will ignore Petrify's damage block.
Bullets also build up Lethal Venom
You have increased Slide Distance, can Slide up hills, and can turn faster while Sliding.
+7.0% Missing health damage and increased Heal per Kill Spirit scaling
Briefly disperse, becoming untargetable and flying to a target location.
Can be recast within a brief window.
On Cast: Gain +25% Fire Rate for 8s and add 8 bullets
Active: Unleash a cloud of bats that seek out targets, each dealing spirit damage and applying Silence.
Passive: Triggering Love Bites against heroes permanently increases the number of bats released.
On Hit: Deal +0.5% Current Health as Damage
Send out a mark that bleeds the first target it hits, dealing spirit damage over time.
While the enemy is bleeding you can re-activate Stalker's Mark to instantly appear behind their back.
Taking any damage passively charges up your Pain Battery.
Once full, activating the ability fires multiple shocking bolts, dealing spirit damage once per target.
On Hero Hit: Heal for 15% of your missing health and increased Spirit scaling
Deal spirit damage to yourself. Then, gain bonus regeneration and bonus move speed, decaying over time.
Unleash pain, dealing spirit damage over time to both enemies and yourself.
The damage continues to increase the longer the ability is channeled, up to a maximum amount.
Enemies receive 20% Move and Dash Slow
Release a wave after taking lethal damage, applying a diminishing slow.
After a brief channel you reanimate, dealing spirit damage and applying stun to nearby enemies.
While On Cooldown: Gain +15% Fire Rate and 6.0 Spirit Damage per Bullet
Target an area with latent magic, applying slow.
The magic detonates after a delay, dealing spirit damage and applying immobilize.
On Hit: Reduce Spirit Resist by -18% for 6s
Release a wave of spectral knights and steeds that charge across the entire city, healing allies and dealing spirit damage to enemies.
The strength of the heal and spirit damage is amplified as the knights travel further.
Place two connected doors in the world. Players and most projectiles entering one door will exit out through the other. The doors will close at the end of the duration.
The two doors must be placed within the doorway distance of each other.
Grants a Barrier first time traveling through doors
Passive: Melee hits restore ammo and inflict wrecked on the victim for 7.0s.
Active: Bullets are amplified against wrecked enemies. Using melee boosts max health and extends duration.
+1 Bashdown Charge on use and +7% Wrecked Bullet Amp
+50 Melee Bonus Health and increases spirit scaling
Previous recorded cooldown change: 30s to 24s, May 19th, 2025.
Previous recorded cooldown change: 110s to 100s, September 4th, 2025.
Return to Shadows cooldown reduced from 100s to 90s
Previous recorded cooldown change: 14s to 12s, July 29th, 2025.
